title: should reveal trace inputs and append ordered single-quoted --trace flags on the Linux install step
verifies: the Linux 'eBPF traces' variant reveals four inputs and appends single-quoted --trace-* flags in order

title: should swap nested language tabs for eBPF inputs and emit Helm --set-string flags
verifies: the Kubernetes eBPF variant swaps the language toggle for three inputs and emits Helm --set-string ebpf.trace.* flags

title: should gate the Linux trace command on requireOneOf and restore it once a selector is filled
verifies: the Linux requireOneOf guard hides the command until a selector is filled (serviceName alone does not satisfy it)

title: should gate the eBPF command on requireOneOf and emit one --set-string per filled selector
verifies: the Kubernetes eBPF guard clears on the first selector and emits ordered --set-string flags with --set ...=null for blanks

title: should render no eBPF traces toggle or trace inputs on Windows and macOS host agents
verifies: Windows and macOS host agents render a single install code block with no tracing toggle or trace inputs

title: should expose the eBPF tracing guide link on Linux and Kubernetes cards
verifies: the card footer exposes an eBPF tracing guide link on both Linux and Kubernetes
